levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: The learner needs a reminder or direct prompt from an adult before starting any part of the routine.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: The learner starts and completes the whole routine on their own, without a reminder, confirmed by the adult the next morning.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Same as proficient, and the learner starts the routine earlier in the evening than the minimum needed, leaving spare time.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: The outfit set out is missing a piece the weather requires, such as a needed jacket, or includes an item that is not actually clean.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: The full outfit, shoes, and one bag item are set out, matching the weather, and every piece is confirmed clean.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Same as proficient, and the learner names the specific weather detail (temperature or precipitation) that drove a layering choice.

lookFors: The adult confirmation happens the next morning, not the night the routine was set up.
The reflection response names a specific rushed or unrushed detail from a real morning, not a general feeling statement.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
